name: Omnifex Convergence
descriptionTemplate: This turn, the Final DMG of your Command Cards +15%. Gain [Arg1] Keyflare. {Discover} 5 Skill Cards from the current Realm, choose up to 3 to place into hand and treat them as Tawil's cards; these cards gain {Exhaust} and {Retain}. The next Command Card Tawil plays takes effect 1 additional time.
lore:
One life, all things.
She commands time and space, and from her fingertips flows a world of order.
Omnifex Convergence.
Inorganic and organic matter blend into chaos, and eventually, they will return to nothing in the breath of Him.
